newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: OZ trebles first quarter 1997 profit.
newsitem.headline: OZ trebles first quarter 1997 profit.

text.p: OZ Holding, which invests in financial services companies, said its profit in the first quarter of 1997 rose to 28.0 million Swiss francs from 9.8 million in the same 1996 period.
OZ Holding, part of Martin Ebner's BZ Group, also said in a statement that income from securities amounted to 28 million francs, compared with 29 million for the full 1996 year.
Income from commissions was seven million in the first quarter compared with 15 million for the full 1996 year.

OZ, whose participations include OZ Zurich AG and Sweden's OM Gruppen AB, also said its equity was 185 million francs as of March 31, or 307 francs per share, compared with 175 million on December 31, 1996, or 291 francs per share.
OZ said a detailed interim report would be published on April 18.
